#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        int len = 1;
        while (i + 1 < s.length() && s[i] == s[i+1]) {
            len++;
            i++;
        }
        if (len % 2 == 0) res++;
    }
    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
